recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: fix edition matching and record expansion in "'`openlibrary/catalog/merge/merge_marc.py`.

Implemented: `add_db_name`, `expand_record`, and `threshold_match` in merge module; `editions_match` expands raw records through `threshold_match`; catalog utils re-exports shared helpers. Missing titles no longer earn short-title score, and empty author/contributor fields are treated as absent.

TDD: initial test collection failed because `add_db_name` was absent. A later missing-title regression test failed with `assert True is False` at threshold 515 before the scoring fix. Targeted merge tests now pass (13 passed, 1 expected failure).

Verification pending: full repository pytest suite. `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`); local grep/find used.
EOF
pytest . --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=infogami --ignore=vendor --ignore=node_modules -q --reruns 0 > /tmp/codex-pytest-output.txt 2>&1; test_status=$?; tail -80 /tmp/codex-pytest-output.txt; exit "$test_status"'

/bin/bash -lc 'pytest . --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=infogami --ignore=vendor --ignore=node_modules -q --reruns 0 > /tmp/codex-pytest-final.txt 2>&1; test_status=$?; grep -E '"'"'^(FAILED|ERROR|= [0-9]+ failed|= [0-9]+ passed)'"' /tmp/codex-pytest-final.txt | tail -15; exit \""'$test_status"'

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
